validity: Thresholds are conventions chosen for reproducibility, calibrated to nothing yet (there is no benchmark corpus): a score is a pure function of the counters, not a measurement of quality.

styling.label: styling code is present in the audited folders
styling.note: no styling code in the audited folders: no markup or style files and no styling counter above 0

tailwind.label: a Tailwind class vocabulary is present
tailwind.note: no Tailwind class vocabulary found (no font-size, spacing or radius utilities, no default-palette classes, no @theme rule): the items that read Tailwind classes are not rated

markup.label: component source files are present
markup.note: no markup files (tsx, jsx, vue, svelte) among the audited files: the item is not rated

limits: Every share divides by all audited files, so adding files with no styling raises it: the dirty-file count is printed beside each share, and the 20-file flag exists for this.
Density counts files whose only hits are raw px values (a file already counted for raw colour is not counted twice); font sizes written as px are in both density and the type axis.

The colour axis counts a file with both a raw colour and a default-palette class once (the larger of the two counts, a lower bound on dirty files); the line colour_axis_if_no_file_holds_both gives the other bound.
Palette classes and the spacing and type axes assume Tailwind; on a repo with no Tailwind vocabulary they are not rated and the report says so.

A declared exemption is applied to font-size, spacing and radius counts (the counters carry the split there) but not to colour literals (they carry none); an exemption that covers more than 10 percent of the audited files is ignored.
Severity Info is decided by path words (a components/ui/ folder, a path word brand or logo), not by what the file holds.

tokens.label: Token conformance: mean of colour, spacing, type, radius (each 0-100; an axis with nothing to rate, or no Tailwind where it needs it, is left out)

floor.floor_note: no token source resolved: nothing can conform, tokens scores 0

parts.label: Colour: audited files without a raw colour (literal not in var(), or default-palette class); a file with both counts once
parts.zero_note: the scanner audited no files: colour axis not rated

parts.label: Spacing: 1 - raw px/rem/em spacing values per audited file
parts.zero_note: no audited files: spacing axis not rated

parts.label: Type: font-size utilities that resolve to a declared token (a named size counts only when the theme maps that very size)
parts.zero_note: no font-size utilities found: type axis not rated

parts.label: Radius: named or var() radius classes / all radius utilities
parts.zero_note: no radius utilities found: radius axis not rated

mean_ratio.zero_note: no axis could be rated: tokens not rated

density.label: Density: audited files with no raw px value (a file whose hits include a colour is already counted in the colour axis)

ratio.zero_note: the scanner audited no files: density not rated

components.label: Components: tag-weighted canonical reuse over Button, Badge, Card, Input (a canonical tag renders components/ui, a package, or the only definition of its name); 5 tags or more

ratio.min_den_note: fewer than 5 Button, Badge, Card or Input tags outside components/ui/: too few to rate, components not rated
ratio.zero_note: no Button, Badge, Card or Input usage found: components not rated

health.none_note: no sub-score could be rated: health not rated

lines.label: Tailwind default named font sizes as a share of all font-size utilities (a named size is credited in tokens.type only when the theme maps it)
Named font sizes whose very name the theme maps (--text-<name> or --font-size-<name>)
Scanner colour hits that sit in files unreachable from any entry point

ratio.zero_note: no colour hits in parsed files

lines.label: Files that use a canonical primitive but that no file imports (reuse in dead code)

ratio.zero_note: no file uses a canonical primitive

lines.label: Scanner colour hits that are colour calls with a var() argument (token references, left out of the dirty-file count)
Colour axis if no file held both a raw colour and a default-palette class (the other bound of the colour axis)

flags.text: the audited folders hold as many test files as audited files: test files are left out of every share, so a file renamed *.test.* or moved under __tests__/ is not audited
colour calls whose argument is var() are token references: they are left out of the dirty-file count, which is therefore the upper bound min(files with colour hits, literal colour hits)
20 or more audited files hold raw colour literals: a high clean share over a large population does not mean few files drift, read the file count beside the share
the token source holds more than 2 raw colour literals per custom-property declaration: it may hold ordinary rules, which the scan exempts and no score sees

ratio.zero_note: the token source declares no custom property

flags.text: the token source holds more than 2 raw px values per custom-property declaration: it may hold ordinary rules, which the scan exempts and no score sees

ratio.zero_note: the token source declares no custom property

flags.text: no Tailwind class vocabulary found: the spacing and type axes and the default-palette check are not rated

info_rules.label: a components/ui/ folder (a vendored UI kit)
a path word brand or brands (brand data)
a path word logo or logos (official logos)

rules.recommend: adopt the resolved token source and consolidate raw colours into it (do not scaffold a second token file)

recommend.partial: scaffold, seeded from the inferred tokens, then consolidate
recommend.mature: existing: adopt the resolved token source and wire drift-only
